Set your route before you ride. Only use the phone controls while parked.
You are responsible for using OmoAuto lawfully. Showing navigation or other content on your motorcycle\'s display may not be permitted everywhere.
No account, no ads, no analytics. OmoAuto sends the Android Auto picture only to your motorcycle over its Wi-Fi. Setup downloads public sample keys from GitHub only when you tap Get keys.
